findings: Solved 2026-10-29 on the owner's request (Practice, Book exercises): the Chapter 19 exercise as printed (PDF 153-155, printed 149-151) with answers in English and Roman Urdu: 10 MCQs (numbered 19.1-19.9 with 19.9 printed twice), 8 short answer, 7 constructed response, 6 comprehensive questions and 6 numerical problems. Drafts for the academic review.
The book prints no MCQ key; the keys are worked out from the chapter: 19.1 b, 19.2 c, 19.3 c, 19.4 c, 19.5 a, 19.6 d, 19.7 d, 19.8 c, 19.9 d, second 19.9 (the tenth MCQ) b.

Owner rule BOOK-CORRECTION-01 applied: all printed questions and options keep the book's wording (e.g. 'radio nuclide', 'Neutron', 'a radioactive tracers', 'neutron are absorbed', 'different to', 'radiam', units missing on m_p and m_n in numerical 19.1); no printed wording was changed. MCQ 19.7 option d is printed 'd)' without the opening bracket (layout only).
Book correction, MCQ numbering: the tenth MCQ is printed as 19.9 a second time (box after it).

Book correction, numerical 19.4: the starting mass is not printed, so the question cannot be solved as printed; the printed answer 3 years fits 1/64 remaining after 18 years (32 g out of 2048 g). Worked on that reading, with a box.

Book correction, numerical 19.5: printed 1.68 x 10^7 m s^-1; with 5.56 MeV and m_alpha = 4 u = 6.64 x 10^-27 kg, v = 1.64 x 10^7 m s^-1 (the printed value needs m about 6.3 x 10^-27 kg). 'radiam' is printed for radium (kept in English, explained in the box; Roman Urdu says radium).

Book correction, numerical 19.6: printed 19.2 MeV; the masses given (old physical-scale values) give dm = 0.01861 u, i.e. 17.4 MeV with 1 u = 1.66 x 10^-27 kg and c = 3 x 10^8 (17.3 MeV with 931.5 MeV/u).

Numerical 19.1: with the four-decimal masses dm = 4.0 x 10^-30 kg and B.E = 2.25 MeV; the printed 2.23 MeV is the value from more exact masses (rounding only, not marked as an error). Numericals 19.2 (9.67 h) and 19.3 (2.5 g) agree with the book. Numerical 19.5 uses the alpha mass 4 u, which the question does not print.
Doubtful/print: CRQ 19.4 activity read from the page image as 10 x 10^4 Bq (the text layer shows '10 x 10°'); answer 1.25 x 10^4 Bq.

Beyond the chapter (labelled in the answers): the proton-proton chain in the Sun (short 19.6); boron-10 neutron capture reaction 10B + n -> 7Li + alpha + 2.8 MeV (CRQ 19.7); deuterium from sea water and the inherent safety of fusion (CRQ 19.2); surface nucleons and the short-range nuclear force versus long-range proton repulsion (comprehensive 19.4); the concrete shield (comprehensive 19.3). MCQ 19.2 (gamma rays from nuclear de-excitation) relies on the previous chapter.
